faq.question: How much does window replacement cost in Tiburon?
faq.answer: Tiburon homeowners typically invest $16,000 to $50,000+ for window replacement projects. This exclusive Marin peninsula — with panoramic views of San Francisco Bay and some of the highest per-square-foot real estate in California — features waterfront estates and hillside homes with large custom windows. Marine-grade specifications are mandatory. Single window installation starts at approximately $800.

faq.question: Do I need a permit to replace windows in Tiburon?
faq.answer: Yes. Tiburon requires a building permit for window replacements. The Town of Tiburon's Design Review Board reviews exterior changes for properties with significant view corridors or within the town's scenic overlay. Our team manages all permit and design review applications on your behalf.

faq.question: Is it worth replacing 20-year-old windows in Tiburon?
faq.answer: Often yes. Twenty-year-old windows in Tiburon commonly show fogged glass, drafts and weak locks. Newer ENERGY STAR units improve comfort and curb appeal; Deluxe Windows compares payback against your utility rates and home style before recommending replacement.

faq.question: Should I choose fiberglass or vinyl windows in Tiburon?
faq.answer: Vinyl is the value pick for most Tiburon replacements and handles Bay Area weather well. Fiberglass (including Marvin Ultrex) is stronger, more stable in temperature swings and better for larger openings or coastal exposure. We show both side by side in the showroom and on-site.

faq.question: How long does window replacement take in Tiburon?
faq.answer: Most Tiburon projects are measured in one visit and installed in one to three working days once products arrive — typically four to eight weeks after ordering, depending on brand and custom sizes.
